dashboard.label: Security Content Lab
dashboard.description: Supported launch integration for the external NetSpout detection-validation engine.

div.p: Browse pinned Splunk Security Content metadata, inspect dependencies, selectively retrieve bounded Attack Data, and validate read-only SPL. Dataset transfer and simulation run in the external companion engine, never in the Splunk search-head process.
Configure and authorize the companion engine in Connection Center before replay. Upstream content is untrusted until reviewed.
